title: Bloodline Mystery
next_chapter_hook: While Chen Ji was still digesting those shocking truths, deep within the Tianqing Sect thousands of miles away, a pair of murky old eyes suddenly opened—Ling Yuan had sensed the anomaly in the ruins.

text.content: The warmth transmitted through his fingertips caused Chen Ji's whole body to jolt. That was not the sensation of ordinary jade, but a pulse resembling a living creature—as if a slumbering heart was slowly awakening within the depths of the fragment. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently on the first page, his voice carrying for the first time an undisguised panic: 'The second page... to unseal at this moment...' Before the words finished, a blinding golden light burst forth from the fragment, violently dragging Chen Ji's divine sense into a chaotic void.

Within the void, a majestic stone coffin hovered at the center of the chaos. Chen Ji approached instinctively, and by the faint glow, he discerned the inscriptions on the coffin—a祭祀文字 from ancient times, chronicling the origins of two surnames: 'The Chen and Ling clans share one origin, descended together from the Ancient Blood Emperor.' At the center of the coffin lid,赫然雕刻着一枚双鱼缠绕的印记，which matched the pattern on the ancestral jade pendant Chen Ji had worn since childhood, down to the finest detail.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the void, carrying a weight Chen Ji had never heard before: 'Child, why do you think Ling Yuan was chosen by the Tianji Record thirty years ago? And why did he become so frenzied when the Tianji Record abandoned him and sought you?' After a pause, the remnant soul's voice grew even lower, 'Because he is your... paternal uncle. The Ling and Chen families split eight hundred years ago. Your grandfather's lineage retained the inheritance qualification for the Tianji Record, while his lineage... has coveted this fortune for generations.'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Paternal uncle? That old man in the sect who showed him 'every care' and often sent spiritual medicines and treasures was actually entangled with him in such a blood-feud-like grudge? He forcibly suppressed the tidal wave in his heart, yet his gaze involuntarily fell upon a hidden compartment beside the stone coffin—inside lay a shattered communication jade slip, its surface covered with cracks of age, yet still bearing a trace of faint spiritual power fluctuation.

The moment Chen Ji probed his divine sense into the jade slip, a mournful female voice резко响起: 'Brother Ji, save me! They want to sacrifice me to—' The voice cut off abruptly, as if someone had掐断 it. Chen Ji's blood instantly turned cold. That voice... was his sister Chen Nian, who had been missing for five years, alive unseen, dead unfound! At the bottom of the jade slip, a line of tiny characters appeared: 'Holy Sect · Heavenly Fate Altar · Prison Cell Wu.'

Chen Ji's knuckles whitened from force. His sister was still alive, and in the Holy Sect's grasp—that demonic path leader, that evil force that slaughtered all living things. Yet simultaneously, the inscriptions on the stone coffin, Ling Yuan's true identity, the eight-hundred-year heritage this coffin carried... each and every one called him to investigate, to uncover. His heart felt as if torn by two opposing forces, blue veins throbbing faintly at his temples.

Meanwhile, in the secret chamber deep within the Tianqing Sect. Ling Yuan's originally murky eyes suddenly burst forth with two rays of brilliant light, and a jade talisman he had been fiddling with shattered with a sound. His form rose from the meditation cushion, an indecipherable smile appearing on his aged face: 'Interesting... that little废物 actually triggered the Ancestral Secret Realm.' He waved his hand, and several black shadows silently appeared before him, 'Go, invite those old fellows over—tell them the second page of the Tianji Record... is about to appear.'

Inside the ruins, the second page of the Tianji Record slowly unfolded before Chen Ji, golden text appearing like flowing water, only to shatter and disperse the next moment. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: 'This page records the art of 'Bloodline Tracing'—it allows you to see the blood kinship between yourself and any person.' After a pause, the remnant soul's tone became exceptionally grave, 'But child, the Tianji Record never makes a losing trade. To施展 this art, you need to consume 30 points of Heavenly Fate Value... and your current total is less than a hundred.'

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Thirty points of Heavenly Fate Value... that was one-third of his current total. Once over-consumed, what awaited him would be irreversible decline. Yet if he didn't investigate the truth, how could he cope with the approaching storm? Furthermore, news of his sister burned his nerves like a branding iron—with every moment of delay, Chen Nian faced greater danger.

choice.prompt: In this desperate situation where bloodline and kinship intertwined, Chen Ji had to make a choice—pursue the truth of his identity that might turn the tide, or embark at all costs on the journey to rescue his sister?

choices.description: 施展 Bloodline Tracing to confirm the blood relationship between Ling Yuan and himself, and take no hasty action until the truth is revealed.

choices.visible_reward: Obtain ironclad evidence of Ling Yuan's blood relationship, which can serve as a fatal trump card at a critical moment
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value drops significantly, and the timing for rescuing his sister may be delayed accordingly
choices.process_label: 你决定先揭开这尘封八百年的血脉之谜

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, formed seals with both hands, and quietly chanted an obscure ancient incantation. The Bloodline Tracing art burst forth, an enigmatic power surging from his Brow Center, probing directly into the depths of the stone coffin. In the instant golden light blazed, countless scenes flickered through his Mental Sea like a carousel—eight hundred years ago to the Ancient Blood Emperor, three hundred years ago to the Chen-Ling division, thirty years ago to the Tianji Record's choice... and a name he had never seen: Chen Xuan.

'Chen Xuan...' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a startled cry, 'How could he appear here? Child, the Chen Xuan you see is your great-grandfather—it was he who entrusted the Tianji Record to our remnant souls for protection, and it was he who personally severed the blood bond between the Chen and Ling families. Do you think Ling Yuan wants you dead? Because the blood flowing in your veins is the only orthodox lineage that threatens his inheritance qualification!'

choices.visible_cost: Lose the chance to confirm Ling Yuan's identity
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate Value, can immediately启动 rescue plan, but lacks ironclad evidence against Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: The mystery of his identity remains unsolved, Ling Yuan's true purpose is still shrouded in fog
choices.process_label: 你决定妹妹的安危高于一切，哪怕放弃揭开真相的机会

text.content: Chen Ji violently withdrew his divine sense, and the golden page bearing the Bloodline Tracing slowly faded before his eyes. He couldn't gamble—his sister's life was the only one; he couldn't afford to lose. From this moment, his original 'gradual plan' was torn to shreds, replaced by a head-on confrontation with the Holy Sect.

'Are you certain?' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a trace of undetectable approval, 'This path is destined to be thorns and brambles; without ironclad identity evidence, you will lose your most important bargaining chip.' Chen Ji offered no reply, merely retrieving from his bosom that jade slip recording Chen Nian's voice, his fingertip gently stroking his sister's final plea for rescue. His gaze was terrifyingly calm: 'Bargaining chips can be found again, but Nian'er is the only one.'

choices.memory_label: 妹妹的安危成为我此生唯一的执念

choices.description: Compromise solution—first use the Tianji Record's remaining foresight ability to lock onto his sister's location, then gradually investigate the identity truth.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and injected a wisp of Heavenly Fate Value into the first page of the Tianji Record. The defective foresight ability activated once more, blurry images within a three-hour window flickering in his mind like reflections in water—the direction toward the Holy Sect was correct, but the specific location was shrouded by a诡异的 mist. The only clear image was: a young woman locked in chains, gazing at the moon outside the window with despairing eyes.

'That's Nian'er!' Chen Ji nearly lost composure. That was his beloved sister, the guilt and longing of five years nearly breaching its dam at this moment. But he quickly收敛了情绪, turning his gaze to the inscriptions on the stone coffin—since he couldn't施展 Bloodline Tracing for now, he would first memorize these clues. 'Mo Xiansheng,' his voice恢复了惯常的平静, 'Regarding the past between Ancestor Chen Xuan and Ling Yuan, how much more do you know?'

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul沉默了许久. When he spoke again, his voice carried a weariness bordering on desolation: 'Chen Xuan discovered Ling Yuan's wicked heart and his ambition to monopolize the Tianji Record, so before his death he altered the inheritance rules—transferring the qualification to his direct grandson's lineage, which is your father.' After a pause, the remnant soul's image trembled slightly before Chen Ji, 'Yet your father, to protect you, sent you to the Tianqing Sect as a menial servant while he himself led Ling Yuan's pursuit away... his survival unknown to this day.'

Chen Ji's fist slowly tightened within his sleeve. Father... so he was not some abandoned orphan, but a stake protected by his father's very life. All those years of humiliation and suppression he endured at the Tianqing Sect, all the bitterness he swallowed through gritted teeth—now found their answer at this moment—those were not fate's mockery, but Ling Yuan's deliberate arrangement.

At this moment, a沉闷的震动 echoed from deep within the ruins. The stone slabs beneath Chen Ji's feet began to crack, and sharp sword qi shot from all directions—someone had triggered the ruins' defense mechanism! 'Damn it...' he cursed under his breath, his form flickering like a specter to evade the dense sword qi. Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang out: 'It's Ling Yuan's men! Though he cannot enter, he can interfere with the ruins' operation through external force—hurry, before the passage is completely sealed, find another exit!'

Chen Ji hesitated no longer. After memorizing the inscriptions on the stone coffin, he followed the spiritual energy fluctuations toward the exit at breakneck speed. The mechanisms along the path疯狂启动 behind him—boulders collapsing, flames erupting, toxic mists billowing—Ling Yuan clearly had no intention of letting him leave alive. But he was, after all, the meticulous Chen Ji. He produced from his sleeve a substitute talisman he had prepared beforehand, shattered it, and a clone fled in the opposite direction while his true self slipped away through a concealed 地脉裂隙, emerging into the night.

When Chen Ji stood once more in the valley outside the ruins, dusk was approaching. The setting sun stretched his shadow long, illuminating his expressionless face—yet his heart, like the sun about to sink into darkness, churned with tumultuous rage and icy killing intent. Ling Yuan, the Holy Sect, and his imprisoned sister... these three forces had somehow formed a诡异的 intersection at this very moment.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul appeared once more, his voice feebler than before: 'Child, your current strength is still far from sufficient. Ling Yuan is an old monster at the Transformation God stage, and the Holy Sect is an even greater leviathan...' The remnant soul's image flickered, seemingly about to dissipate, 'The core objective of Volume Five is to find Chen Nian, but before that, you need more bargaining chips. Ye Qing—the Demonic Path Saintess—she is the only ally you can争取 at present. Remember, her 'Demonic Path Mist' can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record; this is your key to dealing with Ling Yuan.'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly nodded. Ye Qing, that Demonic Path Saintess he had intimidated with the Tianji Record's foresight ability during Volume Three, thereby choosing cooperation. She was a thorn in the Holy Sect's eye, yet also the sharpest hidden blade in his hand. If he could combine her forces with his own scheming, perhaps together they could tear an opening in the Holy Sect's fortress-like cage.

At this moment, a transmission talisman pierced through the air, hovering before Chen Ji. The talisman bore no text, only a familiar dark purple mark—that was Ye Qing's exclusive seal. Chen Ji furrowed his brow slightly, reached out and shattered the talisman, and a voice only he could hear resounded in his Mental Sea: 'Young Master Chen, there is unusual activity in the Holy Sect. They seem to be preparing a grand sacrifice... and the offering is a woman with the surname Chen. My people have learned she is imprisoned at the 'Heavenly Fate Altar' on the northern slope of the Holy Mountain—Prison Cell Wu.'

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Ye Qing's intelligence perfectly matched the information he had obtained from the jade slip—this was no coincidence, but the gear of fate had begun to turn. Prison Cell Wu, Heavenly Fate Altar, a woman with the surname Chen... all clues pointed to the same conclusion: his sister Chen Nian was precisely the sacrifice the Holy Sect had long been preparing!

choice.prompt: Faced with Ye Qing's proactive overture and his sister's dire situation, Chen Ji needed to decide his next move—immediately team up with Ye Qing to formulate a rescue plan, return to the Tianqing Sect for deliberation, or proactively enter the situation to probe Ling Yuan's bottom line?

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. With灵力凝聚 at his fingertip, he traced a complex rune in the void—that was the emergency contact formation Ye Qing had left him. The moment the rune formed, a cold strand of demonic energy surged forth, transforming into a illusory mirror. Ye Qing's enchanting yet cold visage appeared in the mirror, her brow bearing a rare gravity: 'Young Master Chen, your response was faster than I anticipated.'

text.content: After a long沉思, Chen Ji ultimately did not reply to Ye Qing. He tucked the dark purple-marked talisman fragment into his sleeve and turned to leave. Ye Qing's intelligence was固然重要, but at this moment he needed a trump card that would place him beyond defeat—and that trump card might lie within the Tianqing Sect. Su Qingyao, that woman who time and again tried to expose his true nature... it was time for her to be of use.

text.content: A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He did not choose to conceal his whereabouts; instead, he swaggered toward the nearest town—a place with a merchant establishment that had dealings with the Tianqing Sect, one of his usual intelligence-gathering outlets. As expected, less than half an hour after entering the town, a familiar spiritual energy fluctuation approached from the shadows. It was Ling Yuan's people, and they had come faster than he anticipated.

Regardless of the choice Chen Ji made, the gears of fate had already ground to a halt. The moment he departed the ruins, deep within the Tianqing Sect thousands of miles away, Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back before a window, gazing at the distant horizon. A profound smile appeared on his aged face: 'Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, you think triggering the second page can change anything?' His voice was low and icy cold, 'What of the Ancient Blood Emperor's bloodline? Your sister is in my hands, your father's fate is unknown, and even Mo Xiansheng, the one you trust most... has a secret even he himself does not know.'

Ling Yuan slowly turned, producing from his sleeve a jet-black token. The token's surface bore a诡异的 rune, resembling the Holy Sect's emblem—yet subtly carrying the shadow of the Tianqing Sect. 'Go,' he instructed the black shadow before him, 'Tell the Saintess that an old friend has a grand gift for her. The one in Prison Cell Wu... it is time to put her to use.' The words fell, and the rune on the token blazed骤然, a chilling威压 gushing from Ling Yuan's body—in truth, what kind of Transformation God stage old monster was this? Clearly a terrifying existence that had long surpassed the Great Ascension stage!
